metrics.responseRateHint: The share of booking requests this host answered — accepted or declined — in the last {days} days. Requests closed because the dates went to another guest, or withdrawn before the host could decide, are left out.
metrics.responseTimeHint: Median time from a guest sending a request to the host answering it, over the last {days} days. Only decisions the host made in person count; vehicles on Instant Book are excluded.
metrics.acceptKeepHint: The share of requests this host accepted AND saw through, over the last {days} days. Declining within the deadline does not count as accepting, and cancelling after accepting takes the trip back out of this number. A guest who does not pay, or who cancels, does not affect it.
metrics.instantBookHint: This host accepts trips automatically, so requests are answered at once. Because a machine answers rather than a person, we do not turn that into a number of minutes.
metrics.basis: Based on {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} in the last {days} days.
metrics.insufficient: Not enough data yet — only {count, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} in the last {days} days.
metrics.insufficientHintLabel: Why there are no figures yet
metrics.insufficientHint: We only show percentages once there have been at least {min} requests. Below that, a single answer would read as 100% or 0% — a confident-sounding number that tells you nothing.
